series.name: PV1800 2K/3K HM (service manual fault-to-main-board mapping)
series.notes: CRITICAL SEMANTIC DIFFERENCE: in this service manual the same numbers do NOT name a user-visible symptom - each number points at a main-board repair section. E.g. 01 here means 'replace fan, else check fan drive circuit (3.9)', whereas 01 in SERIES 1 means 'fan locked when inverter is off'. Never present these mappings to a customer as the code's meaning. Codes present here: 01, 02, 03, 06, 08, 09, 52, 56, 57, 58, 72, plus the no-LCD symptom.

aliases: No LCD display when inverter turns on

title.en: No LCD display on power up
title.ur: Power up par LCD display nahi

meaning.en: The unit powers on but the LCD stays dead, so the service manual starts diagnosis at the battery voltage.
meaning.ur: Unit power ho jata hai lekin LCD bilkul dead rehta hai jis se service manual battery voltage se diagnosis shuru karta hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage is outside the 44 V to 52 V service window.
causes.ur: Battery voltage 44 V se 52 V service window se bahar hai.

causes.en: The battery switch-on power supply circuit has failed.
causes.ur: Battery switch-on power supply circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Control board or display board has failed and needs replacing.
causes.ur: Control board ya display board kharab ho gaya aur replace karna hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then test battery voltage; the manual states the range is 44v-52v.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karke battery voltage test karein, manual kehta hai range 44v-52v hai.

solutions.en: If the voltage is in range, power the unit on and see whether it starts at all.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage range mein hai to unit power on karke dekhein ke woh start hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it does not run, disconnect all connections, open the surface panel, take out the main board, and check and repair per section 3.7.
solutions.ur: Agar na chale to saare connections disconnect karke surface panel kholein, main board nikaalein, aur 3.7 ke mutabiq check aur repair karein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

title.en: HM board path: fan replacement then 3.9
title.ur: HM board hal: fan badalna phir 3.9

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 01 routes the technician to fan replacement first, then main board section 3.9.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 01 technician ko pehle fan replacement phir main board section 3.9 par le jata hai.

causes.en: Fan is faulty.
causes.ur: Fan kharab hai.

causes.en: Fan drive circuit on the main board is faulty if a new fan does not clear it.
causes.ur: Naya fan se clear na ho to main board ka fan drive circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: First to replace the fan, to check whether it is okay; if NG, please inspect the main board and repair according to 3.9.
solutions.ur: Pehle fan replace karke check karein ke theek hai ya nahi; NG nikle to main board inspect karke 3.9 ke mutabiq repair karein.

solutions.en: Measure the fan drive circuit components listed in section 3.9 (R319/R329, R321/R325/R326/R331, R320/R330, D62/D65, Q34/Q35) with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Section 3.9 mein diye gaye fan drive circuit ke components (R319/R329, R321/R325/R326/R331, R320/R330, D62/D65, Q34/Q35) multimeter se check karein.

solutions.en: After any repair, follow the manual's Test Guidance after Repairing before returning the unit to the customer.
solutions.ur: Har repair ke baad customer ko dene se pehle manual ka Test Guidance after Repairing follow karein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

title.en: HM board path: NTC circuit check 3.8
title.ur: HM board hal: NTC circuit check 3.8

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 02 routes the technician to the NTC circuit, section 3.8.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 02 technician ko NTC circuit section 3.8 par le jata hai.

causes.en: One of the three NTC thermistors is short-circuited or open.
causes.ur: Teen NTC thermistors mein koi aik short-circuited ya open hai.

causes.en: NTC in position HS3 plugs into SW1 on the main board, so a wrong or loose plug can trigger 02.
causes.ur: HS3 position ka NTC main board par SW1 mein plug hota hai, is liye galat ya loose plug 02 kara sakta hai.

solutions.en: Please to check the main board and repair according to 3.8 - the manual's exact wording for 02.
solutions.ur: Manual ka 02 ke liye exact alfaz: 'Please to check the main board and repair according to 3.8'.

solutions.en: Check each NTC with a multimeter; the manual gives reference values such as 5.7k ohm for NTC4 and 15k for the HS4 NTC.
solutions.ur: Har NTC multimeter se check karein, manual NTC4 ke liye 5.7k ohm aur HS4 NTC ke liye 15k jaisi reference values deta hai.

solutions.en: If a function test is impossible, short the NTC and retest; if the fault disappears the NTC was the cause.
solutions.ur: Agar function test mumkin na ho to NTC short karke dobara test karein, agar fault hat jaye to NTC hi wajah thi.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 03 routes the technician to the DC fuse/capacitance, rectifier and MOSFET protection sections.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 03 technician ko DC fuse/capacitance, rectifier aur MOSFET protection sections par le jata hai.

causes.en: DC fuse or bulk capacitors on the main board are faulty (section 3.1).
causes.ur: Main board ka DC fuse ya bulk capacitors kharab hain (section 3.1).

causes.en: Rectifier diode or AC charging circuit is faulty (sections 3.6).
causes.ur: Rectifier diode ya AC charging circuit kharab hai (sections 3.6).

causes.en: MOSFETs on the DC terminal are short-circuited (section 3.7).
causes.ur: DC terminal ke MOSFET short-circuited hain (section 3.7).

solutions.en: Please to check first and then to repair the main board according to 3.1, 3.6 and 3.7 - the manual's exact wording for 03.
solutions.ur: Manual ke 03 ke exact alfaz: 'Please to check first and then to repair the main board according to 3.1, 3.6 and 3.7'.

solutions.en: Per section 3.7, measure PV to BAT- with a multimeter; the manual states anything above 10k is a short and the MOSFETs must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Section 3.7 ke mutabiq PV se BAT- multimeter se check karein, manual kehta hai 10k se upar short hai aur MOSFETs replace karne hain.

solutions.en: If one or more MOSFETs are short-circuited, replace them, then follow the manual's Test Guidance after Repairing.
solutions.ur: Aik ya zyada MOSFET short ho to unhein replace karein, phir manual ka Test Guidance after Repairing follow karein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

title.en: HM board path: BUS module check 3.3
title.ur: HM board hal: BUS module check 3.3

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 06 routes the technician to the BUS module, section 3.3.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 06 technician ko BUS module section 3.3 par le jata hai.

causes.en: BUS module rectifier diode or bus capacitor on the main board is faulty.
causes.ur: Main board ka BUS module rectifier diode ya bus capacitor kharab hai.

causes.en: BUS soft-start circuit is faulty.
causes.ur: BUS soft-start circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: First to start up the inverter by only connecting battery, if the fault is still on, please inspect the main board following 3.3.
solutions.ur: Sirf battery connect karke inverter chala kar dekhein, fault phir bhi aaye to 3.3 ke mutabiq main board inspect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the BUS module devices listed in section 3.3 with a multimeter, checking diode forward drop and bus capacitor value.
solutions.ur: Section 3.3 mein diye gaye BUS module devices multimeter se check karein, diode forward drop aur bus capacitor value dekh kar.

solutions.en: If more than one device in the BUS module is damaged, the manual advises replacing them all rather than guessing.
solutions.ur: Agar BUS module mein ek se zyada devices damage hon to manual unhein tamam replace karne ki salah deta hai.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

title.en: HM board path: control board replacement
title.ur: HM board hal: control board replacement

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 08 says restart and check for repeat, and if it repeats the control boards must be replaced.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 08 kehta hai restart karke dobara check karein, aur dohrae to control boards replace karne hain.

causes.en: Control board has failed, causing a repeat fault on every restart.
causes.ur: Control board kharab ho gaya hai jis se har restart par fault dohra raha hai.

causes.en: A repeat fault after restart means the fault is not external wiring.
causes.ur: Restart ke baad fault dohrana is baat ka nishan hai ke masla external wiring ka nahi hai.

solutions.en: To restart the inverter, to check whether the fault repeats - the manual's exact first step for 08.
solutions.ur: Manual ka 08 ka pehla step: 'To restart the inverter, to check whether the fault repeats'.

solutions.en: If yes, it requires to replace the control boards.
solutions.ur: Agar haan, to control boards replace karne hain.

solutions.en: Before replacing, isolate AC, PV and battery and confirm the external wiring and battery are sound, so you do not swap a good board.
solutions.ur: Replace karne se pehle AC, PV aur battery disconnect karke external wiring aur battery theek check karein taake khurd board na badal dein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 09 routes the technician to four main-board sections covering the boost module, BUS, inverter bridge and soft start.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 09 technician ko chaar main-board sections par le jata hai: boost module, BUS, inverter bridge aur soft start.

causes.en: DC/DC boost module section 3.1.2 fault.
causes.ur: DC/DC boost module section 3.1.2 ka fault.

causes.en: BUS module section 3.2.1 fault.
causes.ur: BUS module section 3.2.1 ka fault.

causes.en: Invert full bridge section 3.4.1 fault.
causes.ur: Invert full bridge section 3.4.1 ka fault.

causes.en: BUS soft start circuit section 3.5 fault.
causes.ur: BUS soft start circuit section 3.5 ka fault.

solutions.en: To check the main board following 3.1.2, 3.2.1, 3.4.1 and 3.5 and to repair accordingly.
solutions.ur: 3.1.2, 3.2.1, 3.4.1 aur 3.5 ke mutabiq main board check karke repair karein.

solutions.en: Measure the power devices in each section with a multimeter; the manual lists diode and IGBT reference values per position.
solutions.ur: Har section ke power devices multimeter se check karein, manual har position ke liye diode aur IGBT reference values deta hai.

solutions.en: Per the manual's own note, if you cannot be sure which component broke, replace them all rather than leave a guess in the unit.
solutions.ur: Manual ke apne note ke mutabiq, agar sure na ho ke kaun sa component toota, to tamam replace karein, unit mein andaza na chhod dein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 52 says restart on battery only, and if it continues check the main board at 3.1.2 and 3.4.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 52 kehta hai sirf battery par restart karein, phir bhi rahe to 3.1.2 aur 3.4 main board check karein.

causes.en: DC/DC boost module section 3.1.2 is faulty.
causes.ur: DC/DC boost module section 3.1.2 kharab hai.

causes.en: Invert full bridge section 3.4 is faulty.
causes.ur: Invert full bridge section 3.4 kharab hai.

solutions.en: First to restart inverter by only connecting to battery, if fault continues, then to check the main board according to 3.1.2 and 3.4.
solutions.ur: Sirf battery connect karke inverter pehle restart karein, fault rahe to 3.1.2 aur 3.4 ke mutabiq main board check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the boost module MOSFETs and the full-bridge IGBTs listed in those sections with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Un sections mein diye gaye boost module MOSFETs aur full-bridge IGBTs multimeter se check karein.

solutions.en: The manual states that if one or more IGBTs are broken, all IGBT components should be replaced.
solutions.ur: Manual kehta hai ke aik ya zyada IGBT toot jayein to tamam IGBT components replace karne chahiye.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 56 says check the battery cable connection first, and if good then check and repair the main board at 3.1.1 and 3.1.2.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 56 kehta hai pehle battery cable connection check karein, phir theek ho to 3.1.1 aur 3.1.2 main board check aur repair karein.

causes.en: Battery cable connection is poor, loose or has a high-resistance joint.
causes.ur: Battery cable connection kh-poor, loose ya high-resistance joint wala hai.

causes.en: DC fuse section 3.1.1 is burnt.
causes.ur: DC fuse section 3.1.1 jal chuka hai.

causes.en: DC/DC boost module section 3.1.2 is faulty.
causes.ur: DC/DC boost module section 3.1.2 kharab hai.

solutions.en: First to check the connection of battery cable, if good connection, then please to check and repair the main board following 3.1.1 and 3.1.2 accordingly.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery cable connection check karein, connection theek ho to 3.1.1 aur 3.1.2 ke mutabiq main board check aur repair karein.

solutions.en: Per section 3.1.1, test F1-F6 fuses (F40A/32VDC) with a multimeter continuity test; reference value 0 ohm, failure status open.
solutions.ur: Section 3.1.1 ke mutabiq F1-F6 fuses (F40A/32VDC) multimeter continuity test se check karein, reference value 0 ohm, failure status open.

solutions.en: Check the bulk capacitors C19/C20/C39/C40 (4200uF 35V) for bulging or leakage, and replace any that have vented.
solutions.ur: Bulk capacitors C19/C20/C39/C40 (4200uF 35V) phoolay ya leak hone ke liye check karein, aur jo vent ho jaye use replace karein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

title.en: HM board path: control board replacement
title.ur: HM board hal: control board replacement

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 57 is answered with a direct control board replacement.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 57 ka jawab seedha control board replacement hai.

causes.en: Control board current sensing or logic has failed.
causes.ur: Control board ka current sensing ya logic kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The sensing connector on the control board is loose or its solder joint has cracked, so the board behaves as failed.
causes.ur: Control board par sensing connector loose hai ya uska solder joint crack ho gaya hai jis se board kharab behaves kar raha hai.

solutions.en: To replace the control board - the manual's exact instruction for 57.
solutions.ur: Manual ka 57 ke liye exact instruction: 'To replace the control board'.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and confirm the fault repeats after a battery-only restart before swapping the board.
solutions.ur: Board badalne se pehle AC, PV aur battery disconnect karke sirf battery par restart ke baad fault dohrane ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: After board replacement, follow the manual's Test Guidance after Repairing before returning the unit.
solutions.ur: Board replace karne ke baad unit wapas dene se pehle manual ka Test Guidance after Repairing follow karein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 58 has a two-step test: battery-only restart, then battery plus utility with the switch off to see if it charges.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 58 ka do-step test hai: pehle sirf battery par restart, phir battery plus utility switch band karke charge hone ka check.

causes.en: DC/DC boost module section 3.1.2 fault, so the bus cannot be built from battery.
causes.ur: DC/DC boost module section 3.1.2 ka fault jis se battery se bus nahi banta.

causes.en: BUS module section 3.2.1 or inverter bridge section 3.4.1 fault.
causes.ur: BUS module section 3.2.1 ya inverter bridge section 3.4.1 ka fault.

solutions.en: First to restart inverter by connecting battery only, to check whether it is good.
solutions.ur: Sirf battery connect karke inverter restart karke check karein ke theek hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Second to connect battery and Utility but to keep switch off, checking whether inverter charges battery.
solutions.ur: Doosra step battery aur Utility connect karein lekin switch band rakhein, aur check karein ke inverter battery charge karta hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Otherwise, to check and repair main board according to 3.1.2, 3.2.1 and 3.4.1 accordingly.
solutions.ur: Warna 3.1.2, 3.2.1 aur 3.4.1 ke mutabiq main board check aur repair karein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)

title.en: HM board path: control board replacement
title.ur: HM board hal: control board replacement

meaning.en: On the HM service manual, 72 - a solar-charger warning code in the user manual - is escalated straight to control board replacement.
meaning.ur: HM service manual mein 72 - jo user manual mein solar-charger warning code hai - seedha control board replacement par le jata hai.

causes.en: Control board is not switching the solar charger off at the low battery threshold, so the charger control circuit has failed.
causes.ur: Control board low battery threshold par solar charger band nahi kar raha jis se charger control circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: The low battery detection input on the control board has drifted, so the threshold is never actually reached in software.
causes.ur: Control board par low battery detection input bigad gaya hai jis se software mein threshold kabhi actually reach hi nahi hota.

solutions.en: To replace the control board - the manual's exact instruction for 72.
solutions.ur: Manual ka 72 ke liye exact instruction: 'To replace the control board'.

solutions.en: Before replacing, confirm at night that the charger really is still drawing from PV at a low battery, so you separate a PV wiring fault from a board fault.
solutions.ur: Replace karne se pehle raat ko confirm karein ke low battery par bhi charger PV se le raha hai, taake PV wiring fault aur board fault alag ho sakein.

solutions.en: After replacement, follow the manual's Test Guidance after Repairing.
solutions.ur: Replacement ke baad manual ka Test Guidance after Repairing follow karein.

source.title: Service Manual PV18-2K/3K HM Inverter/Charger (PV1800 2K/3K HM)
